text: Hello. I received treatment from this doctor when I returned to Thailand last month, and I was very impressed. Personally, I feel that since receiving treatment at clinics in Thailand, Tara Clinic is my number one choice. The doctor is very attentive to patients, doesn't rush, and tries to explain the treatment methods, post-treatment instructions, and even dressing guidelines. Personally, I had many problems: a very strong odor in my vagina, itching, abnormal and discolored discharge, lower abdominal pain, a breast tumor, and other issues. While abroad, I went to other doctors, but the vaginal problems didn't improve. I was very worried and anxious. But after returning to Thailand and receiving treatment, all my problems disappeared. In summary, I had many conditions including a vaginal yeast infection, vaginal bacteria, uterine inflammation, and a bladder infection. I had internal examinations and an abdominal ultrasound. The doctor found a chocolate cyst, which was the cause of my lower abdominal pain. But after treatment with the doctor, my symptoms have improved significantly. My discharge is back to normal, the color hasn't changed, and there's no itching. The lower abdominal pain hasn't completely disappeared because of the chocolate cyst, but the odor in my vagina has disappeared, and other problems have lessened. The medical costs might be a bit expensive considering my extensive conditions, but while it was costly, I'm cured. And the doctor didn't charge me extra for my follow-up appointments. We had two check-ups because we had several symptoms, but in the end, the doctor only charged us for the first treatment because the follow-up was for monitoring our condition. We paid a total of 7200 baht for the symptoms we mentioned, including a free cervical cancer screening. Now we are very happy, much more confident, and no longer bothered by anything like before. Thank you so much, doctor! ❤️🙏

Today I went to see the doctor about my symptoms. I wasn't sure if they were warts, so I just asked him to check my symptoms. I was just curious. He did a pelvic exam, which I could understand. He also examined my vaginal discharge, which I could understand. He also performed a cervical cancer test, even though I hadn't told him I wanted one. He told me to wait for the doctor to write a receipt. I also had to wait about an hour for the urine test results, and then he told me the results. I had warts and should get treatment, and I was satisfied.
So I asked how much it would cost today. The doctor told me 2,100 baht, which shocked me. He explained the various expenses, so I told him I didn't want a cervical cancer test, just to check on my symptoms and find out what was wrong. He then said, "Okay, I'll cancel the cervical cancer test." I replied, "Okay," and ended up paying 1,500 baht.
Why is it so expensive just for the test? I'm confused. I usually go to clinics whenever I have problems, and it's not that expensive.
Another thing I'm concerned about is the pelvic exam and vaginal discharge test. The doctor didn't mention any symptoms related to vaginal discharge, but I do have vaginal discharge. And they didn't give me any medicine. Instead of checking for vaginal discharge and giving me medicine, they didn't give me anything. I feel really bad about this clinic.
